facts.text: The Independent evidence label denotes a peer-reviewed study, standard or regulation text, official statistics, third-party test, or government or agency report.
facts.quote: **Independent** (peer-reviewed study, standard or regulation text, official statistics, third-party test, government or agency report)

facts.text: The Vendor evidence label denotes a supplier's own claim, product page, press release, or white paper.
facts.quote: **Vendor** (a supplier's own claim, product page, press release or white paper)

facts.text: The Expert opinion evidence label denotes a practitioner, consultant, or industry-group view without data.
facts.quote: **Expert opinion** (practitioner, consultant or industry-group view without data)

facts.text: The marker “(on-road evidence)” identifies findings proven only for road vehicles.
facts.quote: Findings proven only for road vehicles carry the marker **(on-road evidence)**

facts.text: Standards that had not been issued by October 2026 are marked “(draft)”, “(under publication)”, or “(under revision)”.
facts.quote: standards that had not been issued by October 2026 carry **(draft)**, **(under publication)** or **(under revision)**
